issue.title: Planning call on 'nano' truncates the system prompt to 200 chars (max_model_len 2048)
issue.symptom: Seen in kixf logs 2026-10-30: 'AgentCore: entering planning call with model=nano' → 'Prompt (1581 est. tokens) exceeds context budget (-200)' → 'Truncated system message from 486 to 200 chars', 'Clamping max_tokens 2248 → 518 (context: 2048)'. The planning output was junk ('---\n**Note: This is the last reply of a lo…'). nano is now a proxy to Core's engine (gaia-nano socat → gaia-core:8092), which serves a larger context, but the nano model config still says max_model_len 2048, and _should_use_slim_prompt forces slim for nano on that assumption. Check: what context Core's engine actually allows; whether nano's config should mirror it; whether the planning call should run at all on tool-answered turns.

regression_test.format: pytest functions added by the fix
regression_test.gold:
# candidates/gaia-core/gaia_core/cognition/tests/test_nano_alias_window_rlnp.py
"""rlnp: 'nano' is an alias to Core's engine, so it has Core's window. Its
stale max_model_len of 2048 made the planning call's prompt overflow, which
cut the system message to 200 chars and the planning output to junk."""

import json
import os

import pytest

_CONSTANTS = "/gaia-common/gaia_common/constants/gaia_constants.json"


def _constants():
    if not os.path.exists(_CONSTANTS):
        pytest.skip("gaia_constants.json not mounted")
    return json.load(open(_CONSTANTS))


def test_nano_alias_has_cores_window():
    models = _constants()["MODEL_CONFIGS"]
    nano, core = models["nano"], models["core"]
    assert nano["endpoint"] == core["endpoint"]
    assert nano["max_model_len"] == core["max_model_len"]
